## Overview

An artwork is linked to an exhibition with an **`Exhibited at`** statement on the artwork. The details that only the exhibition catalogue knows (catalogue number, catalogue page, the title as printed, a note) are added to that statement as qualifiers. There is no separate exhibition item. The model is the association between the [Artwork](artwork-datamodel.qmd) model and the exhibition model.

The model is defined in [wikibase-model.json](wikibase-model.json). The tables below are generated from it.

::: {.callout-note}
The field list is **provisional** (version 0.1).
:::

## ER Diagram

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
    EXHIBITION ||--o{ EXHIBITED_AT : "is referenced by"
    ARTWORK ||--o{ EXHIBITED_AT : "has statement"
    PLACE |o--o{ EXHIBITION : "held at"
    PERSON ||--o{ ARTWORK : "creates"

    EXHIBITION {
        string exhibition_id PK
        string title
        date start_date
        date end_date
        string venue_id FK
        string wikidata_qid
    }
    EXHIBITED_AT {
        string artwork_id FK
        string exhibition_id FK
        string catalogue_number "qualifier"
        string catalogue_page "qualifier"
        string title_as_exhibited "qualifier"
        string notes "qualifier"
    }
    ARTWORK {
        string artwork_id PK
        string title
        string creator_id FK
    }
    PERSON {
        string person_id PK
        string name
    }
    PLACE {
        string term_id PK
        string label_en
    }
```

`ARTWORK` is shown with key fields only; see [Artwork Data Model](artwork-datamodel.qmd) for the full entity.

## Why qualifiers instead of a separate item?

The catalogue details belong to one artwork in one exhibition. Qualifiers on the `Exhibited at` statement keep them next to the statement, work for artworks that appear in several exhibitions (one statement per exhibition), and follow the usual Wikidata pattern for exhibition history (P608).

## Classes

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path

model = json.loads(Path("wikibase-model.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ns = model["namespaces"]

def cell(v):
    return "" if v in (None, "") else str(v).replace("|", "\\|")

print("| Class | Label (EN / DE) | Wikidata | CIDOC CRM | Linked Art | LIDO |")
print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for c in model["classes"]:
    if c["key"] not in {"exhibition"}:
        continue
    e = c["equivalents"]
    wd = e.get("wikidata")
    wd_cell = f"[{wd}]({ns['wikidata']}{wd})" if wd else ""
    print(f"| **{c['key']}** | {c['label_en']} / {c['label_de']} | {wd_cell} | {cell(e.get('cidoc'))} | {cell(e.get('linked_art'))} | {cell(e.get('lido'))} |")
```

## Properties

```{python}
#| output: asis
USES = {"exhibition", "qualifier"}

EXTRA = {"exhibited_at"}

print("| Property | Label (EN / DE) | Wikibase datatype | Used on | Wikidata | CIDOC CRM | Linked Art | LIDO |")
print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for p in model["properties"]:
    if not (set(p["used_on"]) & USES or p["key"] in EXTRA) or p["key"] in {"local_id", "instance_of", "wikidata_qid"}:
        continue
    e = p["equivalents"]
    print("| " + " | ".join([
        f"**{p['key']}**",
        f"{p['label_en']} / {p['label_de']}",
        p["datatype"],
        ", ".join(u for u in p["used_on"] if u in USES),
        cell(e.get("wikidata")),
        cell(e.get("cidoc")),
        cell(e.get("linked_art")),
        cell(e.get("lido")),
    ]) + " |")
```

`local_id`, `instance_of` and `wikidata_qid` apply to every class and are listed on the [Artwork Data Model](artwork-datamodel.qmd) page.

## Example

Baldessari catalogue (Sprengel Museum Hannover), artwork `ART002`:

| Statement | Value |
|---|---|
| `Exhibited at` | EXH001 (John Baldessari, Sprengel Museum Hannover) |
| qualifier `Page(s)` | 14; 51 |

## Corrections to the earlier draft

| Earlier mapping | Problem | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Exhibited at: P1431 | P1431 is "executive producer" | P608 "exhibition history" |
| Depth: P2610 | P2610 is "thickness" | P5524 "depth" |
| Acquisition: P1830, provenance: P2670 | Both properties have other meanings | Removed from this model |
| Instance of: Q3305213 | Q3305213 is "painting" | Q838948 "work of art" plus an object type item |
| CIDOC location: P87 | P87 is "is identified by" for places | P55 "has current location" |
| Series: P108 | P108 is "has produced" | Removed from this model |
| Wikibase4Research column | Dropped from scope | Linked Art and LIDO columns |

## CSV template

[templates/exhibition-item.csv](templates/exhibition-item.csv) lists which artwork was shown in which exhibition, and [templates/exhibition.csv](templates/exhibition.csv) holds the exhibitions. The loader turns each row of `exhibition-item.csv` into an `Exhibited at` statement on the artwork, with the catalogue columns as qualifiers.

| File | Columns |
|---|---|
| `exhibition.csv` | `exhibition_id, title, start_date, end_date, venue_id, wikidata_qid` |
| `exhibition-item.csv` | `artwork_id, exhibition_id, catalogue_number, catalogue_page, title_as_exhibited, notes` |
